name: 46225 · Indianapolis, IN
findings: ZIP 46225 (Indianapolis) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46225 (Indianapolis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46225 (Indianapolis) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.
